title: Get GPT partition UUID (PARTUUID)
summary: Retrieve the unique identifier for a GPT partition. Unlike filesystem UUIDs, PARTUUIDs remain stable even if the filesystem is reformatted.

steps.explain: Use lsblk to print only the PARTUUID for the specified device.

placeholders.name: DEVICE
placeholders.description: The block device path, e.g., sda1

steps.explain: Alternatively, use blkid to print only the PARTUUID value.

placeholders.name: DEVICE
placeholders.description: The block device path, e.g., sda1
